output.reason: On its own, [ev-b5f136b4b95a] is just a metric name, but its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to every listed metric. In 3.0.0, metrics that started with `cortex_` change to start with `loki_`, because the default `metrics_namespace` is now `loki`. Setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keeps the old prefix, but that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That gives the subject (metric `cortex_ring_member_heartbeats_total`), the change (renamed to `loki_ring_member_heartbeats_total`), who is exposed (deployments where `metrics_namespace` is not set to `cortex`) and the consequence (the metric is no longer emitted under its old name, so anything querying that name stops getting data).
